Investigating p53 activity in PDAC and Gift of Life single cell dataset

Ahmed Elhossiny (hossiny@umich.edu)

last updated: 31 August, 2023

  • Introduction
  • Scoring genesets of interest & Transcription factor activity scores
  • Plotting genesets scores patterns
    • P53 activity
    • Progenitor-like signature, SMAD4, KRAS and EMT
    • Senescence & IFN response
    • PDAC Subtypes
    • TP53 / TP63 Transcription factor activity score

Introduction

This notebook investigates some gene sigmnatures provided by Jose Lepez based on mouse models testing the PDAC progenitor cell population

Here we subsetted acinar and epithelial cells only and re-run the dimension reduction steps to create new UMAP based on the new variable features.

DimPlot(GoL_PDAC_scRNASeq, raster = T) + DimPlot(epi_subset, raster = T, group.by = 'cell_types')

We can see here the same UMAP using different metadata for the cells

DimPlot(epi_subset, group.by = 'seurat_clusters', label = T, raster = T) +
  DimPlot(epi_subset, group.by = "DiseaseState",  raster = T) +
  DimPlot(epi_subset, group.by = "lesion",  raster = T) +
  DimPlot(epi_subset, group.by = "sample_name", raster = T)

Scoring genesets of interest & Transcription factor activity scores

Here we will be using AUCell to score different genesets provided in each cell. For Transcription factor activity scores, we will use decoupleR package using their run_viper() function that uses viper package for calculating the activity score.

Plotting genesets scores patterns

P53 activity

FeaturePlot(epi_subset, features = c("shp53_DOWN_cluster_1","shp53_UP_cluster_5","shp53_UP_cluster_6"), cols = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")), ncol = 3, order = T, raster = T, pt.size = 1)

Progenitor-like signature, SMAD4, KRAS and EMT

FeaturePlot(epi_subset, features = c("UP_cluster_0","UP_cluster_2","LOH_Vallejo_KRAS_19genes","HallMark_EMT","David_Smad4_dependent_tgfb_response"), cols = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")), ncol = 3, order = T, raster = T, pt.size = 1)

Senescence & IFN response

FeaturePlot(epi_subset, features = c("Senescence_UP","FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP","HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE"), cols = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")), ncol = 3, order = T, raster = T, pt.size = 1)

PDAC Subtypes

FeaturePlot(epi_subset, features = c("classical_TOP30","basal_TOP30","coexpressor_TOP30"), cols = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")), ncol = 3, order = T, raster = T, pt.size = 1)

TP53 / TP63 Transcription factor activity score

FeaturePlot(epi_subset, features  = c("TP53_activity","TP63_activity"), cols = rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")), ncol = 2, order = T, raster = T, pt.size = 1)
